question:
Which of the following will come next to the series?

P, H, D, B, ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87194c20cacd5afe0038482a050cac21a5b59d88d71a4824aab2fad4447d1474.png] Given series: **P, H, D, B, ?** The logic followed here is: 16 ÷ 2 = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 ÷ 2 = 2 ÷ 2 = 1
